1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# Snapshot the top-level files of SRC into DEST/<timestamp>/ and keep only the
     3	# newest KEEP snapshots (default 5).
     4	#
     5	#   backup.sh SRC DEST [KEEP]
     6	set -eu
     7	
     8	usage="usage: backup.sh SRC DEST [KEEP]"
     9	src="${1:?$usage}"
    10	dest="${2:?$usage}"
    11	keep="${3:-5}"
    12	
    13	if [ ! -d "$src" ]; then
    14	    echo "backup: source $src is not a directory" >&2
    15	    exit 1
    16	fi
    17	
    18	stamp="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
    19	target="$dest/$stamp"
    20	mkdir -p "$target"
    21	
    22	count=0
    23	for f in $(ls "$src"); do
    24	    cp -p $src/$f "$target/"
    25	    count=$((count + 1))
    26	done
    27	echo "backup: copied $count file(s) to $target"
    28	
    29	# Snapshot names sort chronologically, so everything but the last $keep goes.
    30	ls -1d "$dest"/*/ | sort | head -n -"$keep" | xargs -r rm -rf

stamp="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"

{"path": "bin/backup.sh", "old_string": "set -eu

usage="usage: backup.sh SRC DEST [KEEP]"
src="${1:?$usage}"
dest="${2:?$usage}"
keep="${3:-5}"

if [ ! -d "$src" ]; then
    echo "backup: source $src is not a directory" >&2
    exit 1
fi

stamp="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
target="$dest/$stamp"
mkdir -p "$target"

count=0
for f in $(ls "$src"); do
    cp -p $src/$f "$target/"
    count=$((count + 1))
done
echo "backup: copied $count file(s) to $target"

# Snapshot names sort chronologically, so everything but the last $keep goes.
ls -1d "$dest"/*/ | sort | head -n -"$keep" | xargs -r rm -rf", "new_string": "set -eu

usage="usage: backup.sh SRC DEST [KEEP]"
src="${1:?$usage}"
dest="${2:?$usage}"
keep="${3:-5}"

case "$keep" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*)
        echo "backup: KEEP must be a non-negative integer" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

if [ ! -d "$src" ]; then
    echo "backup: source $src is not a directory" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Do not let an unmatched glob turn into a literal filename.
shopt -s nullglob

stamp="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
target="$dest/$stamp"
mkdir -p -- "$target"

count=0
for f in "$src"/*; do
    cp -p -- "$f" "$target/"
    count=$((count + 1))
done
echo "backup: copied $count file(s) to $target"

# Snapshot names sort chronologically, so everything but the last $keep goes.
# Bash expands the glob in sorted order and keeps each path as one array item,
# even when the destination or snapshot path contains spaces.
snapshots=( "$dest"/*/ )
snapshot_count=${#snapshots[@]}
if [ "$snapshot_count" -gt "$keep" ]; then
    remove_count=$((snapshot_count - keep))
    for ((i = 0; i < remove_count; i++)); do
        rm -rf -- "${snapshots[i]}"
    done
fi", "replace_all": false}

function.arguments:
{"path": "bin/backup.sh", "old_string": "set -eu

usage="usage: backup.sh SRC DEST [KEEP]"
src="${1:?$usage}"
dest="${2:?$usage}"
keep="${3:-5}"

if [ ! -d "$src" ]; then
    echo "backup: source $src is not a directory" >&2
    exit 1
fi

stamp="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
target="$dest/$stamp"
mkdir -p "$target"

count=0
for f in $(ls "$src"); do
    cp -p $src/$f "$target/"
    count=$((count + 1))
done
echo "backup: copied $count file(s) to $target"

# Snapshot names sort chronologically, so everything but the last $keep goes.
ls -1d "$dest"/*/ | sort | head -n -"$keep" | xargs -r rm -rf", "new_string": "set -eu

usage="usage: backup.sh SRC DEST [KEEP]"
src="${1:?$usage}"
dest="${2:?$usage}"
keep="${3:-5}"

case "$keep" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*)
        echo "backup: KEEP must be a non-negative integer" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

if [ ! -d "$src" ]; then
    echo "backup: source $src is not a directory" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Do not let an unmatched glob turn into a literal filename.
shopt -s nullglob

stamp="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
target="$dest/$stamp"
mkdir -p -- "$target"

count=0
for f in "$src"/*; do
    cp -p -- "$f" "$target/"
    count=$((count + 1))
done
echo "backup: copied $count file(s) to $target"

# Snapshot names sort chronologically, so everything but the last $keep goes.
# Bash expands the glob in sorted order and keeps each path as one array item,
# even when the destination or snapshot path contains spaces.
snapshots=( "$dest"/*/ )
snapshot_count=${#snapshots[@]}
if [ "$snapshot_count" -gt "$keep" ]; then
    remove_count=$((snapshot_count - keep))
    for ((i = 0; i < remove_count; i++)); do
        rm -rf -- "${snapshots[i]}"
    done
fi", "replace_all": false}
